title: Dasakam 7
description: Creation begins with Brahma; Bhagavan calls him to tapas, reveals Vaikuntha and teaches him the knowledge needed to create.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं देव चतुर्दशात्मकजगद्रूपेण जातः पुन-
-स्तस्योर्ध्वं खलु सत्यलोकनिलये जातोऽसि धाता स्वयम् ।
यं शंसन्ति हिरण्यगर्भमखिलत्रैलोक्यजीवात्मकं
योऽभूत् स्फीतरजोविकारविकसन्नानासिसृक्षारसः ॥ ७-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan who manifested in the form of Virat Roopa, again manifested as Brahma, in Satyaloka, which is the highest and loftiest of all the worlds.This Brahma is known as Hiranya Garbha(the golden egg) the cosmic intelligence of all the beings of the three worlds. With the increase of Rajoguna, Bhagwan as this Hiranya Garbha became desirous of creating various beings.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ deva caturdaśātmakajagadrūpeṇa jātaḥ puna-
-stasyordhvaṃ khalu satyalokanilaye jāto’si dhātā svayam |
yaṃ śaṃsanti hiraṇyagarbhamakhilatrailokyajīvātmakaṃ
yo’bhūt sphītarajovikāravikasannānāsisṛkṣārasaḥ || 7-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सोऽयं विश्वविसर्गदत्तहृदयः सम्पश्यमानः स्वयं
बोधं खल्वनवाप्य विश्वविषयं चिन्ताकुलस्तस्थिवान् ।
तावत्त्वं जगतां पते तप तपेत्येवं हि वैहायसीं
वाणीमेनमशिश्रवः श्रुतिसुखां कुर्वंस्तपःप्रेरणाम् ॥ ७-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Inspite of his best efforts, Brahma could not gain knowledge on the means to start the creations and was worried. Brahma heard two pleasant words 'Tapa,Tapa' coming from nowhere, which prompted him to do penance by Bhagwan's will.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
so’yaṃ viśvavisargadattahṛdayaḥ sampaśyamānaḥ svayaṃ
bodhaṃ khalvanavāpya viśvaviṣayaṃ cintākulastasthivān |
tāvattvaṃ jagatāṃ pate tapa tapetyevaṃ hi vaihāyasīṃ
vāṇīmenamaśiśravaḥ śrutisukhāṃ kurvaṃstapaḥpreraṇām || 7-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कोऽसौ मामवदत् पुमानिति जलापूर्णे जगन्मण्डले
दिक्षूद्वीक्ष्य किमप्यनीक्षितवता वाक्यार्थमुत्पश्यता ।
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रमात्ततपसा तेन त्वमाराधित-
-स्तस्मै दर्शितवानसि स्वनिलयं वैकुण्ठमेकाद्भुतम् ॥ ७-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma, seated on the lotus, looked around the surrounding water in all directions and wondered who spoke those words but could not find anyone. Then he took those words as the best advice and did penance for one thousand divine years(3,60,000 years for Mankind). Pleased with his penance, Bhagwan revealed his abode, the Vaikunta.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ko’sau māmavadat pumāniti jalāpūrṇe jaganmaṇḍale
dikṣūdvīkṣya kimapyanīkṣitavatā vākyārthamutpaśyatā |
divyaṃ varṣasahasramāttatapasā tena tvamārādhita-
-stasmai darśitavānasi svanilayaṃ vaikuṇṭhamekādbhutam || 7-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
माया यत्र कदापि नो विकुरुते भाते जगद्भ्यो बहिः
शोकक्रोधविमोहसाध्वसमुखा भावास्तु दूरं गताः ।
सान्द्रानन्दझरी च यत्र परमज्योतिःप्रकाशात्मके
तत्ते धाम विभावितं विजयते वैकुण्ठरूपं विभो ॥ ७-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Vaikunta is beyond the fourteen worlds and free of Maaya, sorrow, anger, delusion, fear or any mental modifications.It is full of supreme bliss and is engulfed with the constant flow of bright effulgence. Bhagwan showed that shining divine abode to Brahma.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
māyā yatra kadāpi no vikurute bhāte jagadbhyo bahiḥ
śokakrodhavimohasādhvasamukhā bhāvāstu dūraṃ gatāḥ |
sāndrānandajharī ca yatra paramajyotiḥprakāśātmake
tatte dhāma vibhāvitaṃ vijayate vaikuṇṭharūpaṃ vibho || 7-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
यस्मिन् नाम चतुर्भुजा हरिमणिश्यामावदातत्विषो
नानाभूषणरत्नदीपितदिशो राजद्विमानालयाः ।
भक्तिप्राप्ततथाविधोन्नतपदा दीव्यन्ति दिव्या जना-
-स्तत्ते धाम निरस्तसर्वशमलं वैकुण्ठरूपं जयेत् ॥ ७-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: In Bhagwan’s abode Vaikunta, live the divine beings who have four arms and their complexion is like deep blue lustre of sapphire who adorn with various gem studded jewels which enlighten the whole place. They reside in aerial cars. They have achieved this high state by the merit of intense devotion to Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yasmin nāma caturbhujā harimaṇiśyāmāvadātatviṣo
nānābhūṣaṇaratnadīpitadiśo rājadvimānālayāḥ |
bhaktiprāptatathāvidhonnatapadā dīvyanti divyā janā-
-statte dhāma nirastasarvaśamalaṃ vaikuṇṭharūpaṃ jayet || 7-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नानादिव्यवधूजनैरभिवृता विद्युल्लतातुल्यया
विश्वोन्मादनहृद्यगात्रलतया विद्योतिताशान्तरा ।
त्वत्पादाम्बुजसौरभैककुतुकाल्लक्ष्मीः स्वयं लक्ष्यते
यस्मिन् विस्मयनीय दिव्यविभवं तत्ते पदं देहि मे ॥ ७-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Surrounded and served by damsels, Goddess Mahalakshmi with slender and beautiful form like  lightning, enchants the whole world with her captivating lustre. She is always present there in Vaikunta due to her deep attachment to the fragrance of Bhagwan’s lotus feet, hence the abode has become a place for astounding riches. Bhattathiri prayed Bhagwan to grant Vaikunta to him as well.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nānādivyavadhūjanairabhivṛtā vidyullatātulyayā
viśvonmādanahṛdyagātralatayā vidyotitāśāntarā |
tvatpādāmbujasaurabhaikakutukāllakṣmīḥ svayaṃ lakṣyate
yasmin vismayanīya divyavibhavaṃ tatte padaṃ dehi me || 7-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तत्रैवं प्रतिदर्शिते निजपदे रत्नासनाध्यासितं
भास्वत्कोटिलसत्किरीटकटकाद्याकल्पदीप्राकृति ।
श्रीवत्साङ्कितमात्तकौस्तुभमणिच्छायारुणं कारणं
विश्वेषां तव रूपमैक्षत विधिस्तत्ते विभो भातु मे ॥ ७-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan then revealed HIMSELF to Brahma, seated on a gem studded throne, adorned with golden crown and other ornaments, shining like thousands of suns. Bhagwan’s chest with the Shrivatsa mark and the lustre of kaustubh jewel gave a crimson hue. Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan  to reveal that divine form to him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tatraivaṃ pratidarśite nijapade ratnāsanādhyāsitaṃ
bhāsvatkoṭilasatkirīṭakaṭakādyākalpadīprākṛti |
śrīvatsāṅkitamāttakaustubhamaṇicchāyāruṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ
viśveṣāṃ tava rūpamaikṣata vidhistatte vibho bhātu me || 7-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कालाम्भोदकलायकोमलरुचीचक्रेण चक्रं दिशा-
-मावृण्वानमुदारमन्दहसित स्यन्दप्रसन्नाननम् ।
राजत् कम्बुगदारिपङ्कजधरश्रीमद्भुजामण्डलं
स्रष्टुस्तुष्टिकरं वपुस्तव विभो मद्रोगमुद्वासयेत् ॥ ७-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s form looked beautiful like the dark clouds, with a hue similar to blue lotus flowers, and with a splendid halo, illuminated all the directions. HIS form with four arms adorned with the sacred conch, discus, mace and lotus with a pleasant face&  a charming smile gave immense pleasure to Brahma.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kālāmbhodakalāyakomalarucīcakreṇa cakraṃ diśā-
-māvṛṇvānamudāramandahasita syandaprasannānanam |
rājat kambugadāripaṅkajadharaśrīmadbhujāmaṇḍalaṃ
sraṣṭustuṣṭikaraṃ vapustava vibho madrogamudvāsayet || 7-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दृष्ट्वा सम्भृतसम्भ्रमः कमलभूस्त्वत्पादपाथोरुहे
हर्षावेशवशंवदो निपतितः प्रीत्या कृतार्थीभवन् ।
जानास्येव मनीषितं मम विभो ज्ञानं तदापादय
द्वैताद्वैतभवत्स्वरूपपरमित्याचष्ट तं त्वां भजे ॥ ७-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Brahma was overwhelmed with ecstasy and fulfilment . He prostrated at Bhagwan’s lotus feet and  prayed that HE surely knew his desire to create, and so he asked for the required knowledge as well as about the unique dual and the non-dual aspect of Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dṛṣṭvā sambhṛtasambhramaḥ kamalabhūstvatpādapāthoruhe
harṣāveśavaśaṃvado nipatitaḥ prītyā kṛtārthībhavan |
jānāsyeva manīṣitaṃ mama vibho jñānaṃ tadāpādaya
dvaitādvaitabhavatsvarūpaparamityācaṣṭa taṃ tvāṃ bhaje || 7-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आताम्रे चरणे विनम्रमथ तं हस्तेन हस्ते स्पृशन्
बोधस्ते भविता न सर्गविधिभिर्बन्धोऽपि सञ्जायते ।
इत्याभाष्य गिरं प्रतोष्य नितरां तच्चित्तगूढः स्वयं
सृष्टौ तं समुदैरयः स भगवन्नुल्लासयोल्लाघताम् ॥ ७-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bhagwan held Brahma's hands and assured him that he would get the knowledge for creation without  getting attached to the creations. Thus motivating Brahma, Bhagwan remained in his heart and prompted him in the act of creation. 
Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan to bless him with good health.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ātāmre caraṇe vinamramatha taṃ hastena haste spṛśan
bodhaste bhavitā na sargavidhibhirbandho’pi sañjāyate |
ityābhāṣya giraṃ pratoṣya nitarāṃ taccittagūḍhaḥ svayaṃ
sṛṣṭau taṃ samudairayaḥ sa bhagavannullāsayollāghatām || 7-10 ||
